name: Villa & Palazzo Aminta
positioning: Family-welcomed lakeside resort in Stresa overlooking the Gulf of the Borromean Islands on Lake Maggiore, a member of The Leading Hotels of the World
best_for: Travelers who want a Lake Maggiore base with a lake-view pool, beach and boat trips to the Borromean Islands

facts.text: Villa & Palazzo Aminta overlooks the Gulf of the Borromean Islands in Stresa, on Lake Maggiore.
The hotel is a member of The Leading Hotels of the World.
Beatrice, Roberto and Daniela Zanetta welcome guests to Villa & Palazzo Aminta.
Interiors feature Venetian terrazzo-style floors, shining marble columns and precious fabrics on the walls.
I Mori Restaurant serves candlelit dinners in the evening.
The hotel has its own wine cellar.
The hotel has a spa offering treatments.
The hotel has a pet-friendly concept.
There is a Tesla connector for electric cars, up to 22 kW.
The hotel offers a bicycle service for visiting Stresa and the surrounding area.
The hotel's nature park has palm trees, azaleas, camellias and rhododendrons.

highlights.text: The hotel has a swimming pool overlooking the lake and a solarium with a view of the Borromean Islands.
The hotel has a beach and moorings used for summer water sports such as water-skiing, parasailing and watercraft.
Guests can rent recreational motorboats for trips to the islands, departing from the hotel's piers.
An Italian Patio sits at the heart of the hotel, with newer rooms arranged around it.
Accommodation includes lake-view suites such as the Liz Taylor Suite and La Borromea Suite, plus the Amintina Luxury Service Apartment.

considerations.text: Skiing and horseback riding are off-site: ski resorts are reached in the nearby Italian and Swiss mountains, and riding stables are a few minutes from the villa.
The water sports from the hotel's beach and moorings are summer activities.
WhataHotel notes limited accessibility due to the historic building design.
